source.title: Senior Delegate Announcement - Africa (January 2021)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Senior Delegate for Africa: Brent Boswell. We want to thank the Board for their work leading this region while a new leader was selected.

Brent was selected by the WCA Board by voting among them, following Section 4 of our [Motion](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/09.2020.1%20-%20Senior%20Delegates.pdf) about Senior Delegates.

We wish Brent the best of luck in fulfilling his new duties. His term as Senior Delegate begins immediately.

The application document of Brent can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1Sp91Cjhol1FvswmescHTThfyzu0-GZ80) if you are interested in viewing it.

translation.title: 非洲高级代表任命公告（2021 年 1 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，Brent Boswell 将担任非洲地区的新任高级代表。感谢董事会在选拔新负责人期间承担该地区的管理工作。

WCA 董事会依据[《高级代表动议》](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/09.2020.1%20-%20Senior%20Delegates.pdf)第 4 节，通过投票选定了 Brent。

祝 Brent 在新岗位上工作顺利。他的高级代表任期即刻开始。

如有兴趣，Brent 的申请材料可在[这里](https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1Sp91Cjhol1FvswmescHTThfyzu0-GZ80)查看。
